title: Connect to a FeatureServer layer and count features
prompt: Write a standalone TypeScript ESM program that connects to the Esri GeoServices FeatureServer hosted at the base URL in the HONUA_EVAL_BASE_URL environment variable and counts the features in service "EvalIncidents", layer 0, using the where clause "1=1". Use @honua/sdk-js (construct a HonuaClient with { baseUrl } and use its featureLayer(service, layer) surface with queryFeatureCount). Print exactly one line to stdout: a JSON object of the shape {"count": <number>}. Exit with code 0 on success.

context.notes: Golden workflow: standalone FeatureServer count via HonuaClient.featureLayer().queryFeatureCount().
